request: In Streak's list, at the left of the days' header (dayHeader), add a label with the id sortHint that says how the list is sorted (state.sort): "Drag to reorder" for manual, "A to Z" for name, "By colour" for color, "Strongest first" for score and "Done last" for status.

reference.message: How the list is sorted, over the list

set./program/list.lisp/list-pane:
(defview list-pane "The list: the days' header, the habits, the empty message, and the app bar." []
  `(node#listPane :anchors {:left 0 :top 0 :bottom 0}
     :width ~computed.listWidth
     :visible ~(or computed.wide (= state.page :list))
     :color @c.bg
     (node#dayHeader :anchors {:left 0 :right 0 :top 56} :height 44 :color @c.bg
       (label#sortHint :text ~(case state.sort
                                    :name "A to Z"
                                    :color "By colour"
                                    :score "Strongest first"
                                    :status "Done last"
                                    "Drag to reorder")
         :textColor @c.muted
         :anchors {:left 16 :top 12}
         :width 160
         :height 20)
       ~(row-day-header))
     (column#habitList :anchors {:left 0 :right 0 :top 100 :bottom 0}
       :gap 4
       :scroll vertical
       :arrows vertical
       :role list
       :label ~(t "app")
       ~(repeat [h computed.order :key (get-in data.ordered [h :id])]
         (habit-row h)))
     ~(empty-list)
     ~(app-bar)))
